headline: Biological priors and feature curation improve omics model accuracy and interpretability
label: Computational Methods For Omics Integration
summary: Domain knowledge is being built into federated, zero-shot, and matrix-factorization pipelines as omics reference resources scale to tens of millions of cells.
synthesis: The common thread is the use of domain structure to constrain computational models of omics data. REEF adds biological priors to vertical federated learning and is benchmarked against NVFlare VFL and LASER on 13 coral multi-omics samples, with the stated contribution being stabilization rather than mere enablement. LLM-scCurator acts on the input side, filtering biological-noise genes from marker lists before prompting, which raises zero-shot cell-type annotation accuracy from 78.4% to 86.1%. The NMF study operates at scale, decomposing 28.5M healthy cells from the Human Cell Census into additive transcriptional programs that can be projected onto new data. What is new across these items is the placement of biological knowledge inside the modelling pipeline, whether as priors, curated features, or a reference basis, rather than in architecture alone.
